description.value: Trees Organic Coffee is a Vancouver institution founded in 1996, famous for in-house-roasted organic coffee and award-winning New York-style cheesecakes prepared fresh daily in a variety of flavours. The Gastown branch sits on Water Street in one of Vancouver's most popular tourist and cycling corridors, offering a welcoming cafe setting with sandwiches, baked goods, and teas alongside their signature roasts. With over a dozen locations city-wide, Trees also runs live music nights and a wholesale roasting operation, giving it an outsized presence in the Vancouver coffee scene.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 96m; rack (2 spaces) at 99m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at treescoffee.com is fully accessible and confirms an active, multi-location chain operating since 1996 with a Gastown branch, consistent with the OSM listing at 321 Water Street. Online ordering and in-store pickup are prominently advertised, confirming takeout. No website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities, so those remain null; the OSM phone number is not echoed on the website (a catering-only number 604.684.5060 appears instead), leaving phone contact unconfirmed.
concerns: Website title and branding reads 'Trees Cheesecake & Organic Coffee' (and 'Trees Cheesecake & Organic Coffee' in footer copyright), while OSM name is 'Trees Organic Coffee' — minor name mismatch.
OSM phone +1-604-895-4211 is not confirmed on the website; the only phone number appearing in fetched content is 604.684.5060 (listed as the catering/ordering line), which differs.
About page states 13 locations while the homepage states 14 — minor internal inconsistency, likely reflects a recently opened or closed branch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe in Gastown with a functioning website and confirmed online ordering. A useful stop for touring cyclists on a busy cycling corridor.
